skill_name: Summarize the story by providing an overview of the main events.
workflow: The Jungle Book follows the story of Mowgli, a young boy who is trained by Bagheera the black panther and Baloo the bear. Together, they embark on a series of adventures that take them across the jungle, confronting enemies such as Shere Khan the tiger and Kaa the python. As Mowgli learns more about his jungle home, he must eventually choose between staying in the jungle and joining civilized world.
